current_evidence: The council's 'Make a planning application' page (last updated 27 October 2026) links only this document, 'Local list (requirements) for the validation of planning applications', and its title reads 'Local List for the Validation of Planning Applications (November 2025)'. A search found no newer version.

issues.detail: All 16 extracted local requirements are placed under 'Full planning' with 'INFERRED' notes (e.g. Air Quality, Archaeology, Dust, Flood Risk, LVIA, Transport, Travel Plan, Planning Obligation). WSCC only determines county-matter minerals and waste applications and the County Council's own development, so these belong under 'Minerals & waste (county)' and 'County own devt (Reg 3)'. Both of those rows are '(none)', apart from one mislabelled item. Householder, Outline, LBC and similar rows say 'national requirements only', although WSCC does not handle those application types at all.
issues.evidence: List: the County Council 'only deals with minerals and waste applications' and 'applications for development by the County Council itself'; it does not deal with household, commercial or residential applications or applications in the South Downs National Park.

issues.detail: Biodiversity Net Gain is placed under 'Variation of condition s73', but the source excludes s73 applications from the BNG requirement (where the original permission was not subject to statutory BNG). The placement inverts the rule.
issues.evidence: 'All applications for Minor and Major Development except for applications made under Section 73 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990'

issues.detail: County-specific local requirements not captured: Alternative Sites Assessment (minerals and waste development on unallocated sites); Need Statement (Community Facilities) (all WSCC development, including schools, libraries, fire stations); Need Statement (Minerals) (new/expanded minerals development on unallocated sites); Need Statement (Waste Management) (new/enhanced waste development on unallocated sites); Recovery v. Disposal Statement (disposal of inert waste to land); Waste Infrastructure Statement (non-waste development within 250m of existing/permitted/allocated waste sites); Working and/or Restoration and Aftercare Scheme (minerals extraction and waste deposit sites); Mineral Resource Assessment (major development in Mineral Consultation Zones; only the MIS half was captured).
issues.evidence: Table 2 Local Validation Requirements rows: 'Alternative Sites Assessment', 'Need Statement (Community Facilities)', 'Recovery v. Disposal Statement', 'Waste Infrastructure Statement', 'Working and/or Restoration and Aftercare Scheme'.

issues.detail: General local requirements not captured: Aerodrome Safeguarding Statement (development over 90m, wind turbines, aviation uses, or within 15km of Gatwick/Goodwood/Brighton City Airport with specified features); Foul and Surface Water Drainage Assessment (new or changed drainage systems); Heritage Statement (affecting listed building, conservation area, non-designated assets or setting); Lighting Assessment (lighting likely visible off site); Noise Assessment (adverse noise potential, noise-sensitive receptors, mineral extraction, noisy waste processes); Public Rights of Way Statement (affecting a PRoW); Stage 1 Road Safety Audit (major applications with highway alteration / new or intensified access / off-site works); Sustainability/Energy/Climate Change Resilience Assessment (minerals, waste and other major applications); Tree (Arboricultural) Survey (felling/pruning or works affecting trees/hedges or RPAs); Topographic Survey & cross-sections (altered land levels); Elevations (new/altered buildings); Site Layout Plans and Planning Statement (all applications).
issues.evidence: Table 2 rows: 'Aerodrome Safeguarding Statement', 'Lighting Assessment', 'Public Rights of Way Statement', 'Stage 1 Road Safety Audit', 'Tree (Arboricultural) Survey/Information', 'Planning Statement - All applications (proportionate and specific to the development)'.

issues.detail: 'Contaminated Land / Land Contamination Assessment' has the wrong trigger. The excerpt is the LCRM guidance reference followed by the LVIA row text, and it is identical to the LVIA excerpt (a duplicate). The source trigger is: contamination known or suspected; sites within 250m of an existing or historic landfill; or a potentially polluting land use proposed.
issues.evidence: Land Contamination Assessment: 'contamination is known to/suspected to exist;' 'sites within 250m of an existing or historic landfill site;' 'a potentially polluting land use is proposed.'

issues.detail: Many triggers are cut off after 'Applications for:' or 'Applications involving:', or quote the 'What is required' column instead of 'When required'. Air Quality gives only the first bullet (putrescible waste) and omits incineration, significant HGV increases and AQMA proximity. Flood Risk gives a policy reference instead of Flood Zones 2/3 and FZ1 sites over 1ha. Archaeology omits its triggers: within/250m of a Scheduled Monument or registered park, LBC, conservation areas, FZ2/3, greenfield over 1ha. Ecological Appraisal quotes content bullets instead of triggers (designated sites, brownfield, demolition, vegetation removal, within 500m of a pond). Fire Statement quotes the description instead of '2+ dwellings or educational accommodation and 18m+ or 7+ storeys'. Transport gives no thresholds (TS: 2,500-4,000 sqm minerals/waste floorspace; TA: over 4,000 sqm, 40+ two-way HGV movements/day, 30/hour or 100/day vehicle movements, or AQMA).
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpts: 'Flood Risk Assessment Applications for: A proportionate Flood Risk Assessment...'; 'Fire Statement Applications for: A Fire Statements is report...'

issues.detail: 'Ventilation / Extraction details (odour)' is not a separate requirement. The excerpt is the EMAQ guidance citation merged with a page footer and the Planning Obligation row. The source requirement is the Odour Assessment, triggered by new/amended waste development with odour-generating processes and by school or institutional kitchens and catering facilities.
issues.evidence: Odour Assessment: 'New/amended waste development involving odour-generating processes;' 'Ventilation/extraction equipment reports should follow EMAQ guidance where appropriate.'

issues.detail: Mislabelled requirement names. The Hydrological/Hydrogeological Assessment (mineral extraction or landfill in SPZ 1-3 or principal/secondary aquifers) is labelled 'Ground investigation / Geotechnical / Basement Impact Assessment'. The School Travel Plan (school expansions of generally 30+ pupils) is labelled as a generic 'Travel Plan' under Full planning, when it is a county own-development (Reg 3) requirement. The Dust Assessment is merged into a generic 'Odour / Dust / Vibration' label.
issues.evidence: 'Hydrological/Hydrogeological Assessment Applications for mineral extraction or landfill/waste deposit in groundwater source protection zones 1, 2 or 3'; 'School Travel Plan Any school expansion...'

issues.detail: 'Environmental Statement (EIA)' is taken from the Number of Copies note ('Additional copies may also be required for EIA development'), not from a local list requirement. 'Highways / access details (visibility splays)' is text from the national Site Boundary Plan row describing what the red line should include, not a separate requirement.
issues.evidence: Site Boundary Plan: 'land required for access from a public highway, visibility splays, landscaping, car parking'.

issues.detail: The tab_items under 'Submission rules' are process text, not requirements: Portal submission preference, PDF file naming, three hard copies, an electronic copy alongside hard copy, 20MB file limit, and minerals form by post. The two 'Policy-driven requirements' items are broken fragments of the Ecological Appraisal trigger ('SAC, SPA, Ramsar sites); nationally designated area (SSSI); locally designated area (e.g.') and of the LVIA guidance column ('Chichester Harbour National Landscape.').
issues.evidence: tab_items: 'Number of Copies Where possible, planning applications should be submitted electronically via the Planning Portal.'; 'Chichester Harbour National Landscape.'

summary: Grokbot's link is the current WSCC Local List (November 2025) and the date is right. But it filed every requirement under 'Full planning' instead of the county's minerals & waste and Reg 3 types, inverted the BNG/s73 rule, garbled or truncated most triggers, and missed about 20 local requirements, including Need Statements, the Waste Infrastructure Statement, Restoration & Aftercare, the Road Safety Audit, PRoW, Lighting, Noise, Heritage, Tree and Drainage.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
